The '''Ceyan Range Raceway''' was an icy podracing course located near the [[Ceyan Range/Legends|Ceyan Range]] mountains on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It stretched for 10.5 miles. [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] was the track favorite.

Other known racers who used to race in the track were: [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]], [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]], and [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]].
